question: Is the attainment of the eight powers identified as the root Kaula?
premises: The eight powers are invoked in this statement.
Attainment of powers is equated with the root Kaula.
The declaration is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
